grundycenter-ia.name: Grundy Center
facts: Founded in 1877 as a railroad town on the Illinois Central Railroad
Named after Felix Grundy, a Tennessee politician and U.S. Attorney General
Home to the annual Grundy County Fair since 1913
Features historic downtown with well-preserved early 20th-century architecture
Known for its strong agricultural heritage and corn production
notableFacts: The town was platted by the Illinois Central Railroad
Has one of Iowa's oldest continuously operating county fairs

princeton-mo.name: Princeton
facts: County seat of Mercer County since 1846
Named after Princeton, New Jersey by early settlers
Historic courthouse built in 1881 still serves the community
Known for its collection of antique shops around the courthouse square
Home to the annual Mercer County Fair, one of Missouri's oldest
notableFacts: Courthouse square is listed on the National Register of Historic Places
Originally called Marion City before being renamed Princeton
